4691-5165-7046.description:
Donate control of Vilis to an opponent using Iroh
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

3286-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
3286-3800-4687.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

6012-6495--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6012-6495--5--195.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
6012-6495--5--195.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-1981-2415-5931.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1621-1895-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-4478.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

628-2034-7215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-6972-7157.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

3678-5256-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5256-6879.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbended land.
Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending the land that entered.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

1940-1965-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

2173-5220-6535-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6081.description:
Cast Black Panther by paying {G}{W}
When Black Panther enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Black Panther triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Black Panther trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a land you control.
Repeat from step 3.
3490-5231-6081.notes: You can have any creature enter the battlefield instead as long as Black Panther is on the battlefield already. You can also start with Black Panther on the battlefield and by placing a +1/+1 counter on a permanent you control, causing the combo to start at step 3.

5411-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5411-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

1414-4417-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1414-4417-4740-6613.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life. It will not enter with a finality counter due to Solemnity.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from Lotus Petal.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat
1414-4417-4740-6613.notes: Your life total will need to be between 4 and 14 depending on your starting storm count. The exact values are as follows, in order from storm count 0 to 4 or higher: 14, 10, 6, 5, 4. These life totals can be reduced further if you have available {B} to pay for Hex Parasite's trigger instead of using life.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2921-3384-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2921-3384-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2060-2511-2577-6431.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

509-1267-3263-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3263-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

3327-4549-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
3327-4549-5686.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

2254-4477-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 0.
2254-4477-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying zero {E}, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greenwarden dies, its last ability triggers; choose not to exile it.
Resolve Chthonian Nightmare's ability, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Greenwarden of Murasa's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

579-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
579-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
579-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

570-3744-4639.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-3744-4639.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Bloom Tender to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Bloom Tender triggers, causing you to loot.
Telekinetic Bonds triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to untap Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control a black and/or red permanent, this combo makes near-infinite mana of those color(s).

2232-2567-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
2232-2567-4050.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating at least seven 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
When the Plants enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times times.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Avenger of Zendikar to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Plants, adding {5}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more lands, this combo nets infinite Plant tokens and infinite colored mana.

579-962-2645.notablePrerequisites: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
579-962-2645.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each opponent to add {B}{R}{G} and you to add {B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Once each player has infinite mana, use any of Staff of Domination's abilities, along with its first ability, to empty your mana pool.
Move to the next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana they lost.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3692-3771-4050-5176.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
3692-3771-4050-5176.description:
Cast Aethersnipe by paying {U}.
Radagast and Animar triggers.
Resolve the Radagast trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1170-2016-2241-2604.description:
Activate Dire Mimic's first ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast Dire Mimic from your graveyard using Serra Paragon's ability by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Serra Paragon.
Activate Dire Mimic's first ability by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Dire Mimic leaves the battlefield, triggering its ability.
In response, repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, resolve all Dire Mimic abilities, causing you to exile it from your graveyard if it's in your graveyard and gain infinite life.
